1.w: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil. A song of love. My heart is stirred by a good word; I am telling my works, O king; my tongue [is] the pen of a swift scribe.

2.w: You are beautiful above the sons of man; favor is poured out from your lips; upon thus God has blessed you forever.

3.w: Gird your sword upon the thigh, O mighty one, [with] your majesty and splendor!

4.w: And [in] your splendor prosper! Ride forth upon a word of truth and gentleness [and] justice; and your right hand will teach you fearful [things].

5.w: Your arrows [are] sharp—the peoples fall under you—in the heart of the enemies of the king.

6.w: Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever; a scepter of uprightness [is] the scepter of your kingdom.

7.w: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; upon thus, God, your God has anointed you with the oil of joy above your companions.

8.w: All your garments [are] with myrrh and aloes [and] cassia; from the palaces of ivory, the harps have made you glad.

9.w: Daughters of kings [are] among your precious ones; the queen stands at your right hand, in gold of Ophir.

10.w: Hear, O daughter, and see; and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father.

11.w: For the king himself desires your beauty, because he [is] your lord—and bow to him—

12.w: and the daughter of Tyre, with a gift; the rich among the people, will seek your face.

13.w: All glorious [is] the daughter of the king inside; her clothing [is] with weavings of gold.

14.w: In various colors she is brought to the king; the virgins following her, companions of hers, shall be brought to you.

15.w: They are brought along with joy and rejoicing; they shall come into the palace of the king.

16.w: In place of your fathers shall be your sons, whom you shall make to [be] princes in all the earth.

17.w: I will cause your name to be remembered through all generations; upon thus the people will praise you forever and ever.
